title: Trump’s war on Stars and Stripes: Why has military newspaper chief quit?
english: Max D. Lederer Jr. has announced his retirement as publisher of the military newspaper Stars and Stripes following ongoing disagreements with the Pentagon and the Trump administration. Lederer indicated that his leadership approach conflicted with the government's desire to exert more control over the publication's editorial content. These tensions intensified after the newspaper reported on sensitive issues, including a mental health crisis involving sailors on the USS Abraham Lincoln.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ወታደራዊ ጋዜጣ የሆነው 'ስታርስ ኤንድ ስትራይፕስ' አሳታሚ ማክስ ዲ ሌደረር ጁኒየር ከፔንታጎን እና ከትራምፕ አስተዳደር ጋር በተፈጠረ አለመግባባት ምክንያት ከኃላፊነታቸው እንደሚለቁ አስታውቀዋል። ሌደረር የሥራ መልቀቃቸውን ያስታወቁት የመንግስት አካላት በጋዜጣው የአርትዖት ይዘት ላይ ተጨማሪ ቁጥጥር ለማድረግ በመፈለጋቸው ነው። ይህ አለመግባባት ጋዜጣው በዩኤስኤስ አብርሃም ሊንከን መርከብ ላይ ስላሉት መርከበኞች የአእምሮ ጤና ችግሮች ዘገባ ካወጣ በኋላ ይበልጥ ተባብሷል።
oromo: Max D. Lederer Jr. hoogganaa gabaasa waraanaa 'Stars and Stripes' ta'anii turan, Pentagon fi bulchiinsa Trump waliin walitti bu'iinsa uumameen walqabatee hojiirraa akka gaggalan beeksisaniiru. Lederer akka jedhanitti, garaagarummaan kun kan uumame qaamoleen mootummaa qabiyyee gabaasichaarratti to'annoo cimaa gochuu waan barbaadaniifi. Walitti bu'iinsi kun gabaasichi dhimma fayyaa sammuu namoota doonii USS Abraham Lincoln keessa jiran irratti gabaasa erga baasee booda kan hammaateedha.

title: ‘We are starving’: Palestinians besieged by settlers in West Bank homes run out of food
english: Palestinian families in the West Bank town of Qusra have been trapped in their homes for 12 days due to an ongoing siege by Israeli settlers. Despite efforts by the local municipality and the UN to provide humanitarian aid, Israeli soldiers are actively blocking food deliveries, causing supplies to spoil and leaving those inside to face starvation. The situation has intensified as settlers attempt to occupy these properties, preventing the trapped residents from leaving their homes or receiving essential care.
amharic: በዌስት ባንክ በቁስራ ከተማ የሚኖሩ ፍልስጤማውያን ቤተሰቦች በእስራኤል ሰፈራተኞች በተጣለባቸው ከበባ ምክንያት ላለፉት 12 ቀናት ቤታቸው ታስረዋል። የአካባቢው አስተዳደር እና የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት የምግብ እርዳታ ለማድረስ ቢሞክሩም፣ የእስራኤል ወታደሮች እርዳታው እንዳይገባ በመከልከላቸው ቤተሰቦቹ ለረሃብ ተዳርገዋል። ሰፈራተኞቹ ቤቶቹን ለመያዝ በሚያደርጉት ጥረት ሳቢያ የተጎዱት ነዋሪዎች ከቤታቸው መውጣትም ሆነ አስፈላጊውን ድጋፍ ማግኘት አልቻሉም።
oromo: Maatiiwwan Falasxiin magaalaa Qusra, kan West Bank keessatti argamtu keessa jiraatan, uwwisa qubattoota Israa'el irraa dhufeen guyyoota 12f mana isaanii keessatti cufamanii jiru. Bulchiinsi naannichaa fi dhaabbanni mootummoota gamtoomaniis gargaarsa nyaataa dhiyeessuuf yaalii godhanis, waraanni Israa'el gargaarsa sana akka hin geenye dhoorguun maatiin kun akka beela'an taasiseera. Qubattoonni kun mana maatiiwwanii kana qabachuuf yaaluu isaaniitiin, namoonni achi keessatti cufaman mana isaanii gadhiisanii ba'uu ykn gargaarsa barbaachisaa ta'e argachuu hin dandeenye.

title: Gaza death toll rises as 10 Palestinians killed in last 24 hours
english: Israeli military operations in Gaza over the past day have resulted in 10 deaths and 25 injuries, according to local health authorities. Many victims are still believed to be buried under debris, preventing rescue teams from providing assistance. Since the conflict began in October 2023, the total number of fatalities has reached over 73,000.
amharic: ባለፉት ሃያ አራት ሰዓታት ውስጥ በእስራኤል ጥቃቶች ቢያንስ 10 ፍልስጤማውያን መገደላቸውንና 25 ሰዎች መቁሰላቸውን የጋዛ የጤና ሚኒስቴር አስታውቋል። አሁንም ብዙ ሰዎች በፍርስራሽ ስር እንደተጠመዱና የአደጋ ጊዜ ሰራተኞች ሊደርሱባቸው እንዳልቻሉ ተገልጿል። ከጥቅምት 2023 ጀምሮ በጋዛ የደረሰው አጠቃላይ የሟቾች ቁጥር ከ73,400 በላይ ደርሷል።
oromo: Godina Gaazaatti guyyoota darban keessa haleellaa Israa'el raawwateen namoonni 10 ajjeefamanii 25 madaa'uu isaanii ministeerri fayyaa achii beeksiseera. Namoonni hedduun haala kanaan miidhaman jala jirmaa fi caccabaa mana jalaatti hafuun gargaarsa hatattamaa argachuuf rakkachaa jiru. Walitti bu'iinsa sadaasa 2023 irraa eegalee jalqabame kanaan waliigalatti namoonni 73,400 ol ta'an du'aniiru.

title: Funeral for 50 Palestinians recovered from Gaza rubble
english: A collective funeral was held in Gaza for 50 Palestinians whose remains were recently discovered under the debris of Israeli airstrikes. The recovery efforts remain severely hampered as Israel continues to prevent the necessary heavy equipment from entering the territory. This restriction persists even though allowing such machinery is a stated requirement of the existing ceasefire agreement.
amharic: በጋዛ በእስራኤል የአየር ጥቃት የፈራረሱ ሕንጻዎች ፍርስራሽ ውስጥ የተገኙ የ50 ፍልስጤማውያን አስከሬን በጋራ ተቀብሯል። እስራኤል ለፍርስራሽ ማስወገጃ የሚያስፈልጉ ከባድ ማሽኖች ወደ ጋዛ እንዳይገቡ ማገዷን ቀጥላለች። ምንም እንኳን የእሳት ማቆም ስምምነቱ እነዚህ ማሽኖች እንዲገቡ ቢፈቅድም እስራኤል እስካሁን እገዳውን አልነሳችም።
oromo: Gaza keessatti namoota 50 kanneen rukuttaa xiyyaaraa Israa'el booda diigamoo jala turanif sirni awwaala waldaa gaggeeffameera. Israa'el meeshalee gurguddaa diigamoo kaasuuf gargaaran gara Gaza akka hin galle dhorkuu ishee itti fuftee jirti. Walii galteen dhaabbii waraanaa meeshaleen kun akka galan kan ajaju ta'us, Israa'el dhorkaa kana hin kaafne.

title: Ex-defence chief’s call for wartime election raises pressure on Zelenskyy
english: Former Ukrainian defense official Mykhailo Fedorov is putting pressure on President Volodymyr Zelenskyy by publicly calling for a presidential election despite the ongoing war. Fedorov argues that democracy should not be held hostage by Russian aggression and that the country needs to address how it functions during a long-term conflict. However, many experts and officials believe that organizing a national vote while under active bombardment remains nearly impossible.
amharic: የዩክሬን የቀድሞ የመከላከያ ባለሥልጣን ሚካሂሎ ፌዶሮቭ ጦርነቱ እየተካሄደ ቢሆንም የአገር አቀፍ ምርጫ እንዲካሄድ በመጠየቅ በፕሬዝዳንት ዘለንስኪ ላይ ጫና ፈጥረዋል። ፌዶሮቭ ዲሞክራሲ በሩሲያ ጥቃት ምክንያት መቆም የለበትም የሚል አቋም ያላቸው ሲሆን፣ ለረጅም ጊዜ በሚቆይ ጦርነት ውስጥ መንግሥት እንዴት መሥራት እንዳለበት መወያየት እንደሚያስፈልግ ይናገራሉ። ይሁን እንጂ ብዙ ባለሙያዎች በጦርነት ውስጥ ሆኖ ምርጫ ማካሄድ እጅግ አስቸጋሪ መሆኑን ይገልጻሉ።
oromo: Hoggantoonni ittisa biyyaa kan duraanii Yukreen, Mykhailo Fedorov, waraanni amma iyyuu kan itti fufaa jiru ta'us, filannoon biyyoolessaa akka gaggeeffamu gaafachuun Prezidaant Zelenskyy irratti dhiibbaa uumaniiru. Fedorov akka jedhutti, dimokiraasiin duula Raashiyaan banteen hidhamaa ta'uu hin qabu akkasumas biyyi kun waraana dheeraa keessatti akkamitti akka of hogganu murteessuun barbaachisaadha. Ta'us, ogeeyyiin hedduun waraana keessatti biyyattii keessatti filannoo gaggeessuun waan hin danda'amne ta'uu dubbatu.

title: Why a Trump envoy’s Kashmir visit has led to US-Pakistan spat
english: Pakistan has formally protested after the US Ambassador to India, Sergio Gor, publicly referred to Indian-administered Kashmir as a key part of India. Islamabad rejected this characterization, maintaining its long-standing stance that the region remains a disputed territory. This diplomatic friction occurred during the ambassador's visit to the area, complicating the delicate balance the US is attempting to maintain in its relationships with both India and Pakistan.
amharic: የአሜሪካው አምባሳደር በህንድ ስር የሚተዳደረው ካሽሚር የህንድ ዋና አካል ነው በማለታቸው ፓኪስታን ተቃውሟቸውን በይፋ አሰምተዋል። እስላማባድ ይህንን ንግግር ውድቅ በማድረግ ክልሉ አሁንም አከራካሪ ግዛት እንደሆነ አጽንኦት ሰጥታለች። አምባሳደሩ ክልሉን በጎበኙበት ወቅት የተፈጠረው ይህ ዲፕሎማሲያዊ አለመግባባት፣ አሜሪካ ከህንድ እና ከፓኪስታን ጋር ያላትን ግንኙነት ሚዛናዊ ለማድረግ የምታደርገውን ጥረት አወሳስቦታል።
oromo: Ambaasaaddarri Amerikaa gara Hinditti ergaman, Sergio Gor, Kaashmiir kutaa Hindii keessaa akka ta'e dubbachuusaaniitiin Pakistan mormii cimaa dhiheessiteetti. Islamaabaad yaada kana kan mormite yoo ta'u, naannichi ammas biyya wal irratti falmamtuu ta'uusaa ibsiteetti. Imala ambaasaaddarichaa kana keessatti uumamuun rakkoon dippiloomaasii kun, Amerikaan biyyoota lamaan wajjin hariiroo gaarii qabaachuuf carraaqqii gootu irratti dhiibbaa uumeera.

title: US debt hits $40 trillion: Who does Washington owe and why does it matter?
english: The national debt of the United States has officially surpassed $40 trillion for the first time. This unprecedented increase is the result of years of heavy government spending, tax cuts, and massive borrowing across multiple presidential administrations, including pandemic-related expenses. Economic experts warn that this mounting debt is not just a government issue but a significant burden that will eventually impact the personal finances of individual citizens.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የብድር መጠን ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ ከ40 ትሪሊዮን ዶላር በላይ ሆኗል። ይህ ታይቶ የማይታወቅ የዕዳ ጭማሪ ለዓመታት ሲካሄድ በቆየ ከፍተኛ የመንግስት ወጪ፣ የታክስ ቅነሳ እና በተለያዩ አስተዳደሮች የተወሰደ ግዙፍ ብድር የመጣ ነው። የኢኮኖሚ ባለሙያዎች ይህ እያደገ የመጣ የዕዳ መጠን የመንግስት ችግር ብቻ ሳይሆን በመጨረሻም በዜጎች የግል የገንዘብ አቅም ላይ ተጽዕኖ የሚያሳድር ከባድ ሸክም መሆኑን ያስጠነቅቃሉ።
oromo: Hanga liqii biyyoolessaa kan Yunaayitid Isteetis yeroo jalqabaaf guddina dolaara tiriliyoona 40 irra ga'eera. Daballii liqii kanaan dura hin mul'anne kun kan dhufe waggoota dheeraaf mootummaan baasii guddaa gochuu, gibira hir'isuu fi bulchiinsota adda addaa keessatti liqii hedduu fudhachuu irraayi. Ogeeyyiin dinagdee liqiin kun kan mootummaa qofa osoo hin taane, gara fuulduraatti jireenyaa fi qabeenya lammiilee dhuunfaa irratti dhiibbaa cimaa kan geessisu ta'uu akeekkachiisu.

title: War on Iran: Trump announces a new campaign to isolate Iran economically
english: President Donald Trump has unveiled a strict new economic strategy intended to isolate Iran globally. This campaign aims to exert maximum pressure on the country by penalizing any international businesses or nations that continue to trade with it. The administration describes these measures as the most severe economic sanctions ever imposed on any single nation.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ኢራንን በዓለም አቀፍ ደረጃ ለማግለል ያለመ አዲስ ጥብቅ የኢኮኖሚ ስትራቴጂ ይፋ አድርገዋል። ይህ ዘመቻ ከኢራን ጋር የንግድ ግንኙነት ያላቸውን ሀገራትና ኩባንያዎችን በመቅጣት በሀገሪቱ ላይ ከፍተኛ ጫና ለመፍጠር ያለመ ነው። የአሜሪካ አስተዳደር እነዚህን እርምጃዎች በማንኛውም ሀገር ላይ ተጥለው ከማያውቁ እጅግ ከባድ የኢኮኖሚ ማዕቀቦች ጋር አመሳስሏቸዋል።
oromo: Pireezidaanti Doolnaald Traamp biyya Iraan addunyaa irraa addaan baasuuf tooftaa dinagdee haaraa fi cimaa ta'e tokko ifa godhaniiru. Duulli kun biyyoota ykn dhaabbata Iraan waliin daldala itti fufan irratti tarkaanfii fudhachuun biyyattii irratti dhiibbaa cimaa uumuuf kan karoorfame dha. Mootummaan Ameerikaa tarkaanfiiwwan kun biyya kamiyyuu irratti hanga ammaatti kan hin mul'anne adabbii dinagdee cimaa ta'uu ibseera.

title: Bangladesh’s government under pressure as youth demand jobs
english: Six months after taking power, Prime Minister Tariq Rahman’s government in Bangladesh is facing significant public unrest. The youth population, who played a central role in the recent political transition, are now demanding immediate improvements to the economy and job market. The nation is currently struggling with severe energy shortages and a high cost of living, putting pressure on the administration to fulfill its promises.

Dargaggoonni jijjiirama siyaasaa biyyattii keessatti gahee guddaa qabaatan, yeroo ammaa carraa hojii fi fooyya'iinsa dinagdee barbaadu. Biyyattiin rakkoo dhiyeessii anniisaa fi gatii gabaa ol ka'een waan qabamteef, mootummaan waadaa inni gale akka raawwatu gaafatamaa jira.

title: Who was Hind Rajab and why is Israel investigating her killing?
english: The Israeli military has finally acknowledged shooting a car in Gaza in 2024 that resulted in the death of six-year-old Hind Rajab and her family members. Although Israel initially denied responsibility, they are now launching a criminal investigation after international pressure and reports highlighted that rescue paramedics sent to save her were also killed by tank fire. Despite this admission, the victim's family and human rights observers remain skeptical that any genuine justice will be served.

oromo: Humnoonni waraana Israa'el bara 2024 magaalaa Gaazaatti intala waggaa ja'aa Hind Rajabii fi maatii ishee kan turan konkolaataa irratti dhukaasa banuudhaan lubbuun isaanii akka darbe amantaniiru. Israa'el jalqaba irra kanatti gaafatamummaa kan hin fudhanne ta'us, dhiibbaa idil-addunyaa fi ogeeyyonni fayyaa ishee gargaaruuf deemaniis miilaa'anii ajjeefamuun isaanii erga mirkanaa'ee booda amma qorannaa yakkaa jalqabaniiru. Ta'us, maatiin ishee fi warri mirga namoomaaf falman jijjiirama dhugaa argachuun akka ulfaatu shakku.

title: Israel is betting on Islamophobia to save its standing in the West
english: The Israeli government is increasingly relying on Islamophobic narratives to maintain political support among right-wing factions in Western nations. By aligning itself with anti-Muslim rhetoric, Israeli officials aim to strengthen ties with political groups that hold exclusionary and bigoted views. This strategy has contributed to rising hostility and discriminatory actions against Muslim communities within the United States.
amharic: የእስራኤል መንግስት በምዕራባውያን ሀገራት የሚገኙ የቀኝ ዘመም የፖለቲካ ቡድኖችን ድጋፍ ለማግኘት በእስልምና ጥላቻ ላይ የተመሰረተ ፕሮፓጋንዳ እየተጠቀመ ነው። እስራኤል ከእስልምና ጥላቻ ጋር በመቀናጀት ከነዚህ አግላይ አስተሳሰብ ካላቸው ቡድኖች ጋር የጠበቀ ግንኙነት ለመፍጠር እየሰራች ነው። ይህ አካሄድ በአሜሪካ ውስጥ በሚኖሩ ሙስሊም ማህበረሰቦች ላይ የሚደርሰውን ጥቃትና መድልዎ በማባባስ ረገድ የራሱ የሆነ አሉታዊ ተጽዕኖ እያሳደረ ይገኛል።
oromo: Mootummaan Israa'el biyyoota dhihaa keessatti deggarsa siyaasaa argachuuf jecha, jibba Islaamummaa irratti hundaa'e itti fayyadamaa jira. Israa'el qalbii garee siyaasaa mirga-qabiyyee (right-wing) kanneen jibba irratti ijaaraman harkisuuf, ragaa fi yaada Islaamummaa faallessu fayyadamti. tarsiimoon kunis Ameerikaa keessatti hawaasa Muslimaa irratti miidhaa fi jibbi akka dabalu sababa ta'ee jira.

title: Exclusive: UK condemns 'abhorrent' Ben Gvir comments on killing Palestinians
english: The British government has strongly condemned recent statements by Israeli National Security Minister Itamar Ben Gvir, who suggested the mass killing of Palestinians in Gaza and promoted the execution of prisoners. UK officials labeled this rhetoric as dehumanizing and unacceptable, warning that such comments only intensify the ongoing conflict. Furthermore, the British government is considering new policy measures and potential trade restrictions in response to Israel's expanding settlement activities in the West Bank.
amharic: የብሪታንያ መንግሥት በእስራኤል ብሔራዊ ደኅንነት ሚኒስትር ኢታማር ቤን ግቪር የተሰነዘረውን የፍልስጤማውያን ግድያ ጥሪ በጥብቅ አውግዟል። የብሪታንያ የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስቴር ቃል አቀባይ ንግግሩን ዘግናኝ እና ሰብአዊነት የጎደለው ሲሉ ገልጸው፣ ይህ አነጋገር ግጭቱን እንደሚያባብሰው አስታውቀዋል። በተጨማሪም፣ በምዕራብ ባንክ የእስራኤል ሰፈራ መስፋፋትን በመቃወም የብሪታንያ መንግሥት አዳዲስ ፖሊሲዎችን እና የንግድ ገደቦችን ተግባራዊ ለማድረግ እያሰበ ነው።
oromo: Mootummaan Britaaniyaa ibsa Ministeera Nageenya Biyyaalessaa Israa'el Itaamaar Ben Gviir kanneen lubbuu namoota Falasxiin irratti aggaamman cimsee balaaleffateera. Mootummaan Britaaniyaa haasaa kana kan balaaleffate yoo ta'u, ibsi kun kan nama gadi qabu fi fudhatama kan hin qabne ta'uu ibseera. Kana malees, Britaaniyaan babal'ina naannolee qubannaa Israa'el kan lixaa baankii irratti deemaa jiru mormuun, tarkaanfiiwwan siyaasaa fi daldalaa haaraa fudhachuuf karoorfateera.

title: Israel issues veiled threat to Turkey following airbase strikes in Syria
english: Israeli Defense Minister Israel Katz has warned Turkey against involvement in Syria after Israeli forces conducted airstrikes near a Turkish-controlled airbase. Israel claims that the presence of Turkish troops in the area threatens its national security and violates previous agreements. Turkey and Syria have denied these accusations, leading to heightened diplomatic tensions between the two nations.
amharic: የእስራኤል መከላከያ ሚኒስትር እስራኤል ካትዝ፣ እስራኤል በሶሪያ በሚገኝ የቱርክ ወታደራዊ ጣቢያ አቅራቢያ ጥቃት ካደረሰች በኋላ ቱርክን አስጠንቅቀዋል። እስራኤል የቱርክ ወታደሮች በሶሪያ መገኘት ለደህንነቷ ስጋት መሆኑን እና ስምምነቶችን የጣሰ መሆኑን ትከሳለች። ቱርክ እና ሶሪያ ይህን ክስ ውድቅ ያደረጉ ሲሆን፣ በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ያለው ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ውጥረት ተባብሷል።
oromo: Ministirri ittisa biyya Israa'el Israa'el Kaatz, tarkaanfii waraana Israa'el buufata xiyyaaraa biyya Sooriyaa keessatti argamu kan Turkii waliin wal qabatu irratti fudhatameen booda, mootummaa Turkii akeekkachiisanii jiru. Israa'el waraanni Turkii naannicha keessatti argamuun isaa nageenya ishee akka midhuu fi waliigaltee duraanii akka cabse himatti. Turkii fi Sooriyaan himannaa kana kan haalan yoo ta'u, kunis hariiroo biyyoota lamaan gidduu jiru caalaatti akka hammeessu godhee jira.

title: Tanker off Yemen boarded by armed people, diverted towards Somalia, UKMTO says
english: A group of six armed individuals seized control of a tanker sailing east of Yemen in the Gulf of Aden. The vessel was subsequently forced to change its course and head toward the coast of Somalia. Authorities have not yet confirmed the current status or safety of the crew members.

oromo: Namoonni hidhatan jahan yemen bahaa fi galaana Aden keessa markaba boba'aa fe'ee deemaa ture to'annoo isaanii jala oolchaniiru. Markabichi karaa isaa jijjiiree gara biyya Somaaliyaatti akka imalu dirqameera. Hanga ammaa haalli nageenyaa namoota markabicha keessa turanii ifa hin taane.

title: Colombia's far-right government waives visas for Israel
english: Colombia’s new far-right government has reached an agreement with Israel to eliminate visa requirements for citizens of both countries starting September 1st. This move is part of a broader strategy by President Abelardo de la Espriella to reverse the previous administration's policies, which had severed ties over the conflict in Gaza. In addition to the visa waiver, Colombia plans to open an embassy in Jerusalem and has officially recognized Israel's control over the Golan Heights.

oromo: Mootummaan Kolombiyaa haaraan mirga fayyadamtootaa kan ta'e, lammiileen biyyoota lamaanii guyyaa Fulbaana tokko irraa eegalee biyya walii seenuuf viizaa akka hin barbaadne waliigalteerra gahuu isaa beekameera. Tarkaanfiin kun prezidaant Abelardo de la Espriella siyaasa biyyattii durii jijjiiruun Israa'elii wajjin hariiroo cimaa uumuuf tattaaffii godhaa jiran keessa isa tokko. title: PSG forced to move opening league match as heatwave in France damages pitch
english: Paris Saint-Germain has relocated its opening league match against Rennes due to severe damage to the Parc des Princes pitch caused by a recent heatwave. The club decided to move the game to ensure the safety and physical well-being of the players, with the agreement of their opponents. PSG plans to have a new pitch installed in time for their next home game scheduled for September 4.
amharic: የፓሪስ ሴንት ጀርመን ቡድን በፈረንሳይ ባጋጠመው ከፍተኛ የሙቀት መጠን ምክንያት የሜዳው ሣር በመጎዳቱ የመክፈቻ ጨዋታውን ወደ ረኔስ ከተማ አስተላልፏል። ክለቡ ይህንን ውሳኔ የወሰነው ለተጫዋቾች ደህንነትና ጤንነት ሲባል ሲሆን፣ ረኔስም ለዚህ ተባባሪ ሆኗል። ፓሪስ ሴንት ጀርመን በመጪው መስከረም 4 ለሚካሄደው የሜዳው ጨዋታ አዲስ የሣር ሜዳ እንደሚተካ ገልጿል።

title: Belgian car salesman becomes prince after royal parentage confirmed
english: Clément Vandenkerckhove, a 26-year-old former car salesman, has been officially recognized as the son of Belgium's Prince Laurent. Although he is now legally a prince, he will not receive a royal allowance, participate in official duties, or be included in the line of succession. He plans to keep his mother's surname to honor her, despite his newfound royal status following a confirmed DNA match.
amharic: የ26 ዓመቱ የቀድሞ የመኪና ሽያጭ ባለሙያ ክሌመንት ቫንደንከርክሆቭ የቤልጂየሙ ልዑል ላውረንት ልጅ መሆኑ በህጋዊ መንገድ ተረጋግጧል። ምንም እንኳን አሁን ልዑል ቢባልም፣ የመንግስት አበል አይደረግለትም፣ በይፋዊ ስራዎች ላይ አይሳተፍም፣ እንዲሁም በዙፋን ተተኪዎች ዝርዝር ውስጥም አይካተትም። አዲሱ ልዑል እናቱን ለማክበር ሲል ያደገበትን ስም እንደያዘ እንደሚቀጥል ገልጿል።
oromo: Gurgurtuu konkolaataa durii kan ta'e umriin isaa 26 kan ta'e Kilement Vaandenkerkihoov ilmi Loo'ula Beeljiyam Loo'ul Laawurent ta'uun seeraan mirkanaa'eera. Amma loolummaa argatus, qarshii mootummaa irraa hin argatu, hojii mootummaa irrattis hin hirmaatu, akkasumas tartiiba aangoo mootummaa irratti hin qabatu. Loo'ulli haaraan kun haadha isaa kabajuuf jecha maqaa ishee akka hin jijjiirre ibseera.

title: How Myanmar’s war drives the Rohingya crisis
english: The ongoing civil war in Myanmar has severely worsened the humanitarian crisis for the Rohingya ethnic minority, leading to mass displacement and reports of extreme violence. Human rights investigations reveal that the Rohingya are caught between the ruling military and the Arakan Army, with both sides accused of conducting targeted attacks and exploitation. This violence has forced thousands to flee, while the region continues to grapple with allegations of human trafficking and systemic persecution.
amharic: በምያንማር እየተካሄደ ያለው የእርስ በርስ ጦርነት ለሮሂንጋ አናሳ ብሔረሰብ የሰብአዊ ቀውስን በማባባስ ከፍተኛ መፈናቀል እና የጭካኔ ድርጊቶች እንዲፈጸሙ ምክንያት ሆኗል። የሰብአዊ መብት ተሟጋቾች ባደረጉት ምርመራ ሮሂንጋዎች በገዥው ወታደራዊ መንግስት እና በአራካን ጦር መካከል በመገኘት ለጥቃት እና ለብዝበዛ ተጋልጠዋል። ይህ ግጭት በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎችን እንዲሰደዱ ከማድረጉም በላይ፣ በሰዎች ዝውውር እና በስርዓት በተደራጀ ጭቆና ምክንያት ህዝቡ ከፍተኛ ስቃይ እየደረሰበት ነው።
oromo: Waraanni biyyaa biyyaa Itoophiyaa keessatti mul'atu kun rakkoo lammiilee Rohingya irratti ga'u hammaachisee, qe'ee isaanii irraa buqqisuufi roorroo cimaan akka isaan irra ga'u taasiseera. Qorannoon mirga namoomaa akka agarsiisutti, ummanni Rohingya kun waraana mootummaafi garee finxaaleyyii 'Arakan Army' gidduutti kufanii, miidhaafi humnaan gudeeddaa gosa garaagaraatiif saaxilamaa jiru. Rakkoon kun nama kumaatamaan lakkaawwamu biyyoota ollaa akka baqatan kan dirqisiise yoo ta'u, daldalli namaafi dararaan iddoo guddaa qabatanii itti fufanii jiru.

title: Why did Uganda unveil a statue of Netanyahu's brother at Entebbe?
english: The Ugandan military recently installed a statue of Yonatan Netanyahu at the Entebbe airport to commemorate the 50th anniversary of a 1976 Israeli hostage rescue mission. The monument was commissioned by General Muhoozi Kainerugaba, who praised Netanyahu's courage during the operation where he was the only Israeli soldier to die. The decision to honor him has sparked controversy, coinciding with Uganda's recent move to deploy troops to Gaza amidst the ongoing Israel-Palestine conflict.
amharic: የዩጋንዳ ወታደራዊ ኃይል በ1976 ዓ.ም የተካሄደውን የታጋቾች ነፃ የማውጣት ተልዕኮ 50ኛ ዓመት ምክንያት በማድረግ የዮናታን ኔታንያሁን ሐውልት በኢንቴቤ አውሮፕላን ማረፊያ አስመርቋል። ሐውልቱ በጄኔራል ሙሆዚ ካይነሩጋባ አነሳሽነት የተሠራ ሲሆን፣ ዮናታን በዚያን ወቅት ለተገኘው የነፃነት ዘመቻ የከፈለውን መስዋዕትነት የሚያስታውስ ነው። ይሁን እንጂ ይህ ድርጊት በጋዛ እየተካሄደ ካለው ጦርነት እና የዩጋንዳ ወታደሮች ወደዚያ እንደሚላኩ በተገለጸበት ወቅት መፈጸሙ በብዙዎች ዘንድ ውዝግብ አስነሳል።
oromo: Raayyaan Ittisa Biyya Yugandaa, yaadannoo waggaa 50ffaa duula bara 1976tti namoota butamanii turan bilisa baasuuf godhamee ture sababeeffachuun, naannoo buufata xiyyaaraa Entebbetti dhaabbata Yonatan Netanyahu ijaarsiseera. Dhaabbanni kun ajajaa waraana Yugandaa Jeneraal Muhoozi Kainerugabaan kan ajajame yoo ta'u, gootummaa Yonatan duula sanarratti agarsiise kan yaadachiisuudha. Haata'u malee, yeroo Yugandaan waraana gara Gaazaatti erguuf karoorfatteefi walitti bu'iinsa Israa'elii fi Falasxiin hammaatee jiru kana keessa dhaabbanni kun ijaaramuun isaa mormii fi gaaffii guddaa uumeera.

title: Syrian official says ‘no plans’ to establish Turkish military presence
english: Syrian Foreign Minister Asaad al-Shaibani has denied claims that Turkey is establishing a military base at the Abu al-Duhur airfield following recent Israeli airstrikes on the site. He clarified that Turkish officials only visited for training purposes and that no permanent military deployment was ever planned. Meanwhile, Israel maintains that the strikes were a warning against Turkish involvement in the area, leading to heightened tensions between the two nations.
amharic: የሶሪያ የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር አስዓድ አል-ሻይባኒ፣ እስራኤል በአቡ አል-ዱሁር የአየር ማረፊያ ላይ ጥቃት ካደረሰች በኋላ ቱርክ በቦታው ወታደራዊ ጣቢያ እንደምትገነባ የሚነገረውን ወሬ ውድቅ አድርገዋል። የቱርክ ወታደራዊ ባለስልጣናት ቦታውን የጎበኙት ለስልጠና ብቻ እንደሆነና በቦታው ቋሚ ወታደራዊ መገኘት እቅድ እንደሌለ አስረድተዋል። እስራኤል በበኩሏ ጥቃቱን የፈፀመችው በቱርክ ተሳትፎ ላይ ማስጠንቀቂያ ለመስጠት እንደሆነ በመግለጽ በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ያለውን ውጥረት አባብሳለች።
oromo: Ministirri Dhimma Alaa Siiriyaa Asaad al-Shaibanii, erga xiyyiin Israa'el buufata xiyyaaraa Abuu al-Duhuur irratti darbee booda, Turkiin buufata waraanaa achi keessatti hundeeffachuu ishee ilaalchisee odeeffamu soba jechuun haalaniiru. Aangeyyoonni Turkiyyi bakke sana kan daawwatan leenjiif qofa akka ta'ee fi waraanni Turkiyyi achi qubachuuf karoora akka hin qabne ibsaniiru. Israa'el gamasaatiin, haleellaan kun hirmaannaa Turkiyyii akkeekkachiisuuf kan raawwatame ta'uu ibsuun, walitti bu'iinsa biyyoota lamaanii hammaachiseera.

title: Taliban secures pragmatic global alliances without formal recognition
english: Five years after returning to power, the Taliban has successfully built regional partnerships in trade, energy, and security despite lacking widespread international recognition. While most of the world has not officially acknowledged their government, the Taliban currently maintains diplomatic engagements with over 40 missions globally. China has become a primary economic partner through major mining investments, even as relations with other neighbors like Pakistan remain complicated.
amharic: ታሊባን ወደ ስልጣን ከተመለሰ አምስት ዓመታት በኋላ፣ ዓለም አቀፍ እውቅና ባያገኝም በተለያዩ የንግድ፣ የኢነርጂ እና የፀጥታ ዘርፎች የክልል አጋርነት መፍጠር ችሏል። አብዛኛው የዓለም ሀገራት መንግስታቸውን በይፋ ባይቀበሉም፣ በአሁኑ ወቅት ከ40 በላይ ዲፕሎማቲክ ተልዕኮዎች ጋር ግንኙነት እየተደረገ ይገኛል። በተለይም ቻይና በትላልቅ የማዕድን ኢንቨስትመንቶች አማካኝነት ዋና የኢኮኖሚ አጋር ሆና ስትቀጥል፣ ከሌሎች ጎረቤት ሀገራት ጋር ያለው ግንኙነት ግን ውስብስብ ሆኖ ቀጥሏል።
oromo: Taliban erga gara aangootti deebi'ee waggaa shan booda, hayyama idil-addunyaa guutuu hin qabaatinillee, daldala, anniisaa fi nageenya irratti walitti dhufeenya naannoo cimaa uumachuu danda'eera. Biyyoonni hedduun mootummaa isaanii ifatti kan hin beekne ta'us, amma yeroo ammaa gartuun sun ergamoota dippilomaasii 40 olii wajjin walitti dhufeenya qaba. Keessattuu Chaayinaan invastimantii qonnaan baasii gurguddaa irratti waliigaltee uumuun hiriyaa diinagdee ijoo taateetti, haa ta'u malee, walitti dhufeenyi biyyoota ollaa kanneen akka Paakistaan waliin qaban ammayyuu xaxamaadha.

title: Israeli authorities release body of slain Palestinian child held since March
english: Israeli authorities have returned the body of a Palestinian child, Salim Sami Salim Faqha, who was killed by military fire near Ramallah in March. The boy's remains were handed over to Palestinian officials for burial after being held by Israel for several months. This practice of withholding bodies has faced significant criticism from human rights groups, who argue it violates international humanitarian laws regarding the respectful treatment of the deceased.
amharic: የእስራኤል ባለስልጣናት መጋቢት ወር ላይ በወታደራዊ ጥቃት የተገደለውን ሳሊም ሳሚ ሳሊም ፋቃ የተባለ ፍልስጤማዊ ህፃን አስከሬን ለቤተሰቦቹ አስረክበዋል። እስራኤል ለወራት አስከሬኑን ይዛ ከቆየች በኋላ ለፍልስጤም ባለስልጣናት ያስረከበች ሲሆን የቀብር ስነስርዓቱም በአገሩ ይከናወናል። ይህ አስከሬን የመያዝ ተግባር አለም አቀፍ የሰብአዊ መብት ድርጅቶችን ተቃውሞ የገጠመው ሲሆን፣ የሟቾችን ክብር የሚጻረር ድርጊት መሆኑም ተገልጿል።
oromo: Abbootiin taayitaa Israa'el ganna darbe ji'a Bitootessaa keessa naannoo Ramallaatti loltootaan ajjeefame ijoollee Phalasteen kan ta'e Saalim Saamii Saalim Faqhaa reeffa isaa maatii isaatiif deebisaniiru. Israa'el reeffa mucichaatii ji'oota hedduuf erga qabattee booda, ergaa achi booda gara dhaabbata fayyaa Phalasteenitti geeffamee akka awwaalamu taasifameera. Gochi reeffa qabachuu kun mirga namoomaa fi seera idil-addunyaa kan cabsu waan ta'eef, dhaabbileen mirga namoomaa gocha kana balaaleffataniiru.

title: Palestine groups call for London march against British 'complicity' in Gaza genocide
english: Pro-Palestine advocacy groups in the UK have scheduled a major protest in London for October 10 to mark the three-year anniversary of the conflict in Gaza. The coalition is calling on the British government to stop supplying arms and military support to Israel, arguing that the UK is complicit in the ongoing humanitarian crisis. Demonstrators are demanding that officials take concrete action to secure a permanent ceasefire and ensure unrestricted access for aid to reach the Palestinian people.
amharic: በዩናይትድ ኪንግደም የሚገኙ የፍልስጤም ደጋፊ ቡድኖች በጋዛ እየተካሄደ ያለውን ጦርነት ሶስት ዓመት ምክንያት በማድረግ በጥቅምት 10 ቀን በለንደን ትልቅ ሰልፍ እንደሚጠሩ አስታውቀዋል። አራማጆቹ የእንግሊዝ መንግሥት ለእስራኤል የሚሰጠውን የጦር መሳሪያና ወታደራዊ ድጋፍ በማቆም በችግሩ ላይ እጁ እንዳለበት በመግለጽ ተቃውሟቸውን ያሰማሉ። ተቃዋሚዎቹ መንግሥት ተኩስ እንዲቆም እና የሰብአዊ እርዳታ ያለ ምንም ገደብ እንዲገባ አፋጣኝ እርምጃ እንዲወስድ እየጠየቁ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Gareen deggartoota Falasxiin kan UK, waraana Gaaza keessatti waggaa sadii guutuu geggeeffamaa jiru mormuuf guraandhala 10 magaalaa Londonitti hiriira guddaa waamanii jiru. Dhaabbileen kun mootummaan Britaaniyaa gargaarsa meeshaa waraanaa Isiraa'eliif kennu akka dhaabuufi dhimma kana keessatti hirmaannaa qabaachuu isaa akka dhaabu gaafachaa jiru. Hiriirtotni mootummaan kun waraana akka dhaabsisuufi gargaarsi namoomaa daangaa malee Falasxiinota bira akka ga'uuf tarkaanfii qabatamaa akka fudhatu gaafatu.

title: Three Palestinian parties in Israel form joint list ahead of elections
english: Three Palestinian-led political parties in Israel have decided to run as a unified coalition in the upcoming October elections. By forming this alliance, the groups aim to increase their parliamentary influence and oppose what they describe as the right-wing government's discriminatory policies. While this group seeks to revive the historical 'Joint List,' the Ra'am party has chosen to remain independent and run its own separate campaign.
amharic: በእስራኤል የሚገኙ ሶስት የፍልስጤም የፖለቲካ ፓርቲዎች በመጪው ጥቅምት ወር በሚካሄደው ምርጫ በአንድነት ለመወዳደር ተስማምተዋል። ጥምረቱን የመሰረቱት ፓርቲዎች በፓርላማ ያላቸውን ተጽዕኖ በመጨመር አሁን ካለው የቀኝ ዘመም መንግስት ፖሊሲዎች ጋር ለመታገል አቅደዋል። ይህ ጥምረት የቀድሞውን የጋራ ዝርዝር (Joint List) ለማደስ ቢሞክርም፣ የራአም ፓርቲ ግን ከጥምረቱ ውጪ በተናጥል ለመወዳደር ወስኗል።
oromo: Paartiileen siyaasaa Falasxiin sadii Israa'el keessatti argaman filannoo guddicha Mudde dhufuuf jedhuuf tokko ta'uun akka dorgoman murteeffataniiru. Paartiileen kun waltajjii siyaasaa keessatti hirmaannaa isaanii dabaluufi mootummaa mirga isaanii sarbe jedhan mormuuf walta'iinsa kana uumaniiru. Yeroo kanaan dura 'Joint List' jedhamuun beekamu deebisanii ijaaruuf carraaqqii godhanis, paartiin Ra'am garuu walta'iinsa kana keessa galuu diduun kophatti dorgomuuf murteeffateera.

title: Israel issues veiled threat to Turkey following airbase strikes in Syria
english: Israel recently launched airstrikes on the Abu al-Duhur airbase in Syria, prompting Defense Minister Israel Katz to warn Turkey against its involvement in the region. While Israel claims the site threatened its security, both Turkish and Syrian officials deny any permanent Turkish military presence, stating that Turkish teams were merely assisting with infrastructure repairs. This confrontation has escalated diplomatic tensions, with Turkey criticizing the strikes as reckless and noting that a pre-existing communication channel between the two nations was ignored.
amharic: እስራኤል በቅርቡ በሶሪያ አቡ አል-ዱሁር የአየር ማረፊያ ላይ የአየር ድብደባ የፈፀመች ሲሆን የመከላከያ ሚኒስትሯ እስራኤል ካትዝ ቱርክ በክልሉ የምታደርገውን እንቅስቃሴ በማስጠንቀቅ ላይ ናቸው። እስራኤል ቦታው ደህንነቷን አደጋ ላይ ጥሏል ብትልም፣ የቱርክ እና የሶሪያ ባለስልጣናት ምንም አይነት የቱርክ ወታደራዊ ይዞታ እንደሌለ በመግለጽ፣ የቱርክ ቡድኖች የነበሩት ለስራ ማሻሻያ ስራ ብቻ መሆኑን አስታውቀዋል። ይህ ግጭት በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ያለውን ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ውጥረት ያባባሰው ሲሆን፣ ቱርክ ጥቃቱን ሀላፊነት የጎደለው ድርጊት ብላ በመቃወም ቀደም ሲል የነበረው የመግባቢያ መስመር ችላ መባሉን ገልጻለች።
oromo: Israa'el dhiyeenya kana buufata xiyyaraa Abu al-Duhur kan Sooriyaa keessatti argamu irratti haleellaa qilleensaa raawwatteetti; Ministirri ittisaa Israa'el Israa'el Kaatz ammoo qindoomina Tarkiin naannichatti qabduun akeekkachiisaniiru. Israa'el bakkeen kun nageenya ishee waan miidhuuf haleellee jettee himattus, qondaaltoonni Tarkii fi Sooriyaa waraanni Tarkii achi akka hin jirre ibsaniiru; akkasumas gareen Tarkii achi turan kan deeggarsa suphaa buura misoomaa qofaaf akka ta'e dubbataniiru. Walitti buutiin kun hariiroo dippilomaasii biyyoota lamaanii kan jabeessu yoo ta'u, Tarkii haleellaa kana balaaleffachuun daandiin quunnamtii isaanii kan dursaa ture utuu jiruu Israa'el isa fayyadamuu dhiisuu ishee ibsiteetti.

title: Jason Arday's marathon challenge and football claims found to be true after his death
english: A recent analysis has confirmed that claims made by the late Cambridge academic Jason Arday, including his completion of 30 marathons for charity, were factual. Arday had faced significant public criticism and media scrutiny regarding his background and achievements following allegations of plagiarism. Despite the controversy surrounding his life and career, evidence supports his past accomplishments in long-distance running and charitable fundraising.
amharic: የቅርብ ጊዜ ጥናት እንደሚያሳየው በካምብሪጅ ዩኒቨርሲቲ መምህር የነበሩትና በቅርቡ ያረፉት ጄሰን አርዳይ በጎ አድራጎት ለማከናወን 30 ማራቶኖችን እንደሮጡ የተናገሩት እውነት መሆኑን አረጋግጧል። በአርዳይ ላይ ከዚህ ቀደም የቅጂ መብት ጥሰት ክሶች ቀርበውባቸው የነበረ ቢሆንም፣ የህይወት ታሪካቸውና ስኬቶቻቸው በተመለከተ የሰነዘሩት የይገባኛል ጥያቄዎች መሰረት ያላቸው መሆናቸው ታይቷል። በአሁኑ ወቅት የተደረገው ትንታኔ የቀድሞ አትሌቲክስ እና የበጎ አድራጎት ስራዎቻቸው እውነት መሆናቸውን በሰነዶች አረጋግጧል።
oromo: Qorannoon dhihoo kana gaggeeffame akka agarsiisutti, ogeessi barnootaa Yuunivarsiitii Kaambirijii kan turan Jason Arday, maratoonii 30 fageenya gabaabaa keessatti fiiguun isaanii dhugaa ta'uun mirkanaa'eera. Arday waa'ee jireenya isaanii fi eenyummaa isaaniitiin walqabatee komii fi gadi-qabbiin miidiyaalee irraa isaan mudachaa ture. Haata'u malee, qorannoon kun akka agarsiisutti, dubbiin isaan waa'ee fiigicha maratoonii fi hojii gaarummaa irratti dubbatan dhugaa ta'uun isaa ragaan mirkanaa'eera.

title: UK to lay out 'measures' against Israel over West Bank settlements
english: The British government has announced plans to implement measures, including potential sanctions, against Israel in response to new settlement construction projects near Jerusalem. Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband warned that these developments threaten the viability of a two-state solution by physically dividing the West Bank. London intends to finalize these restrictive policies in the coming weeks to address illegal settlement expansion and its impact on Palestinian communities.
amharic: የብሪታንያ መንግስት በኢየሩሳሌም አቅራቢያ አዳዲስ ሰፈራዎችን በመገንባቱ ምክንያት በእስራኤል ላይ ማዕቀቦችን ጨምሮ የተለያዩ እርምጃዎችን እንደሚወስድ አስታውቋል። የሀገሪቱ የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር ኤድ ሚሊባንድ እነዚህ የግንባታ ፕሮጀክቶች በዌስት ባንክ ያለውን መሬት ለሁለት በመከፋፈል የሁለት ሀገር መፍትሄን አደጋ ላይ እንደሚጥሉ አስጠንቅቀዋል። እንግሊዝ ይህንን ህገ-ወጥ የሰፈራ ማስፋፊያ ለመግታት በሚቀጥሉት ሳምንታት አጠቃላይ ማዕቀቦችን ተግባራዊ ለማድረግ እያቀደች ነው።
oromo: Mootummaan Biriiteen, ijaarsa manneen jireenyaa haaraa Yerusaalem biratti gaggeeffamaa jiru mormuun, tarkaanfiiwwan adda addaa fi adabbiiwwan irratti xiyyeeffatan fudhachuuf akka jiru beeksiseera. Ministirri Dhimma Alaa biyyattii Ed Miliband, piroojektonni kun lafa Lixa Laga Yordaanos (West Bank) bakka lamatti hiruu dhaan furmaata biyya lamaa kan miidhu ta'uu ibsaniiru. Biriiteen, babal'ina buufataalee seeraan alaa kana dhaabsisuuf torbanoota dhufan keessatti tarkaanfiiwwan cimaa fudhachuuf qophaa'aa jirti.

title: How conflict is making life more expensive for Iranians
english: Iranians are facing severe financial hardship as the country's currency loses value and the cost of basic goods continues to climb. President Trump's recent pledge to intensify economic pressure on the nation has further exacerbated these concerns. Residents in major cities like Tehran are finding it increasingly difficult to afford daily necessities due to this ongoing economic instability.
amharic: የኢራን ብሔራዊ ገንዘብ ዋጋ ማሽቆልቆል እና የኑሮ ውድነት በሀገሪቱ የሚኖሩ ዜጎችን ከፍተኛ ችግር ላይ ጥሏቸዋል። ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ በኢራን ላይ ጠንካራ የኢኮኖሚ ማዕቀብ እንደሚጥሉ ካስታወቁ በኋላ የኑሮ ጫናው ይበልጥ እየተባባሰ መጥቷል። በዚህም ምክንያት የቴህራን ነዋሪዎች የዕለት ተዕለት ፍላጎቶቻቸውን ለማሟላት እየተቸገሩ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Gatiin gabaa dabalaa fi gatiin mallaqa biyyaatii gadi bu'uun isaa ummanni Iraan rakkoo jireenyaa hamaa keessa akka jiran taasiseera. Prezidaantiin Donald Traamp tarkaanfii diinagdee cimaa biyyattii irratti fudhachuuf waadaa galuun isaanii sodaa fi rakkoo kana caalaatti hammaachiiseera. Haala kanaan, jiraattonni magaalaa Teheran gatii meeshaalee bu'uuraa baasuuf rakkachaa jiru.

title: State-backed Israeli settler violence forces West Bank displacement: HRW
english: A new Human Rights Watch report reveals that Israeli settlers, supported by state resources and protection, are systematically forcing Palestinians to leave their communities in the West Bank. The organization reports a significant rise in violent attacks, including assault and property destruction, which have led to more displacement in the first four months of this year than in all of 2025. Consequently, the rights group is urging international authorities to impose sanctions and halt military aid to Israel to address these escalating human rights abuses.
amharic: አዲስ የሰብአዊ መብት ተከራካሪ ቡድን (HRW) ባወጣው ሪፖርት መሠረት፣ የመንግሥት ድጋፍ የሚያገኙ የእስራኤል ሰፋሪዎች በዌስት ባንክ የሚገኙ ፍልስጤማውያንን ከቀያቸው እንዲፈናቀሉ እያደረጉ ነው። ሪፖርቱ በሰፋሪዎች የሚፈጸመው ጥቃት፣ ንብረት ማውደም እና ግድያ ተባብሶ መቀጠሉን በመግለጽ፣ ይህ ድርጊት ከፈረንጆቹ 2025 ዓመት በጠቅላላ ከተመዘገበው በላይ የሰዎች መፈናቀል በአራት ወራት ውስጥ እንዲከሰት አድርጓል ብሏል። የሰብአዊ መብት ተከራካሪ ቡድኑ የዓለም አቀፍ ማህበረሰብ በእስራኤል ላይ ማዕቀብ እንዲጥል እና ወታደራዊ እርዳታ እንዲያቆም ጥሪ አቅርቧል።
oromo: Gabaasni haaraan Human Rights Watch baase akka ibsetti, qubattoonni Israa'el mootummaan deeggaraman, lammiilee Falasxiin naannoo West Bank irraa humnaan buqqisuu isaanii ibseera. Gabaasichi akka jedhutti, haleellaan qubattootaa fi miidhaan qabeenyaa irratti raawwatamu dabaluun, waggaa kana keessa ji'oota afur qofa keessatti namoota hedduu buqqiseera. Haala kanaan, dhaabbatichi mootummoonni biyyoota addunyaa Israa'el irratti tarkaanfii akkasumas gargaarsa waraanaa akka dhaaban gaafateera.

title: Are Hormuz ships more willing to defy Iran or the US? What the data shows
english: Tensions in the Strait of Hormuz have divided shipping routes between those controlled by Iran and those protected by the US. Recent maritime data indicates that commercial vessels are increasingly masking their identities to navigate the waterway safely. Many ships appear more cautious about avoiding Iranian interference than they are about defying American naval directives.
amharic: በሆርሙዝ የባህር በር እየተባባሰ የመጣው ውጥረት የባህር ትራፊክን በኢራን እና በአሜሪካ ቁጥጥር ስር ባሉ መስመሮች እንዲከፈል አድርጓል። የቅርብ ጊዜ የባህር ላይ መረጃዎች እንደሚያሳዩት፣ የንግድ መርከቦች በሰላም ለማለፍ ማንነታቸውን ለመደበቅ እየሞከሩ ነው። አብዛኛዎቹ መርከቦች ከአሜሪካ ትዕዛዝ ይልቅ ከኢራን ጣልቃ ገብነት ለመራቅ የበለጠ ጥንቃቄ እያደረጉ ነው።
oromo: Walitti bu'iinsi giddu gala Hormuz jiru, daandiiwwan markabootaa kan Itoophiyaa fi kan Ameerikaa jidduutti akka qoodaman taasiseera. Odeeffannoon dhihoo kun akka agarsiisutti, markaboonni daldalaa karaa nagaa ta'een darbuuf jecha eenyummaa isaanii dhoksuuf dirqamaniiru. Markaboonni baay'een isaanii ajaja Ameerikaa irra, tarkaanfii mootummaa Iraan sodaachuun of eeggannoo guddaa gochaa jiru.

title: Israeli shelling targets southern Lebanese towns
english: The Israeli military has launched intensive artillery attacks against several towns and valleys located in southern Lebanon. Local news outlets identified the affected areas as including Wadi al-Salouqi, al-Hujair, Hula, and the regions near Qabrikha and Toulene. These strikes represent an ongoing escalation of tensions in the border region.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይል በደቡባዊ ሊባኖስ በሚገኙ በርካታ ከተሞች እና ሸለቆዎች ላይ ከባድ የጦር መሳሪያ ድብደባ ፈጽሟል። የአካባቢው መገናኛ ብዙኃን እንደዘገቡት ጥቃቱ ዋዲ አል-ሳሉቂን፣ አል-ሁጃይርን፣ ሁላን እንዲሁም በቃብሪካ እና ቱሌን አቅራቢያ የሚገኙ አካባቢዎችን ያጠቃለለ ነው። ይህ ድርጊት በድንበር አካባቢው እየተባባሰ የመጣውን ውጥረት ያሳያል።
oromo: Humnoonni waraana Israa'el gammoojjiiwwanii fi magaalota kibba Libaanoos hedduu irratti humnaan rukutaa jiru. Miidiyaaleen naannichaa akka gabaasanitti, magaalotni fi naannawonni rukutaman keessatti Wadi al-Salouqi, al-Hujair, Hulaa akkasumas naannoo Qabrikha fi Toulene kan argamanidha. Tarkaanfiin kun walitti bu'iinsa naannoo daangaa irratti jiru hammeenya isaa agarsiisa.

title: Explainer: Have European countries been involved in the US-Israeli war on Iran?
english: European nations are facing a difficult balancing act regarding the US-led war in Iran, as they try to avoid direct involvement while managing pressure from Washington. Despite many leaders expressing public disapproval, it has been revealed that European-based military facilities have supported thousands of US combat flights. The United Kingdom, in particular, has become deeply involved by allowing the US to launch airstrikes from its territory and deploying its own military assets in the Middle East.
amharic: የአውሮፓ ሀገራት በኢራን ላይ እየተካሄደ ያለውን ጦርነት በተመለከተ ራሳቸውን ከቀጥታ ተሳትፎ ለማራቅ እና ከአሜሪካ የሚደርስባቸውን ጫና ለመቋቋም ጥረት እያደረጉ ይገኛሉ። የብዙሀኑ የአውሮፓ መሪዎች ጦርነቱን በይፋ ቢቃወሙም፣ በአውሮፓ የሚገኙ የአሜሪካ የጦር ሰፈሮች በሺዎች ለሚቆጠሩ የአየር ጥቃቶች ድጋፍ ሲሰጡ ቆይተዋል። በተለይም ታላቋ ብሪታንያ አሜሪካ ከአገሯ መሬት እንድትጠቀም በመፍቀድ እና በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ የራሷን የጦር መሳሪያዎች በማሰማራት በግጭቱ ውስጥ በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ ተሳትፋለች።
oromo: Biyyoonni Awurooppaa waraana Ameerikaan Iraan irratti gaggeessitu ilaalchisee of eeggannoo guddaa gochaa jiru. Hogganoonni hedduun waraanicha mormus, buufataaleen waraanaa Awurooppaa keessa jiran xiyyaarota waraana Ameerikaa kumaan lakkaa'amaniif gargaarsa taasisaniiru. Keessattuu, Biritaniyaan iddoo waraana Ameerikaan akka fayyadamtu hayyamuufi qabeenya waraana ishee gara Baha Giddu galeessaatti bobbaasuun waraana kana keessatti hirmaannaa guddaa qabaatteetti.

title: France: Mosque closure fuels fear of state overreach on Muslim worship
english: A French administrative court has upheld the six-month closure of the Attaqwa Mosque in Aulnay-sous-Bois, which was shut down by local authorities due to allegations of inciting violence and terrorism. While the government claims the imams promoted hatred and extremist views, many local residents and lawyers are criticizing the move as an unfair restriction on religious freedom. The community is frustrated by the collective punishment of worshippers, arguing that officials should target specific individuals rather than shutting down the entire prayer space.
amharic: የፈረንሳይ ፍርድ ቤት በአውልናይ-ሱ-ቡዋ የሚገኘው አታቅዋ መስጂድ፣ ሁከትን እና ሽብርተኝነትን በማነሳሳት ክስ ለስድስት ወራት እንዲዘጋ የተላለፈውን ውሳኔ አጽንቷል። መንግሥት መስጂዱ ጥላቻን የሚሰብኩ ስብከቶችን ያስተናግዳል ሲል ቢከስም፣ የአካባቢው ነዋሪዎች እና ጠበቆች ይህ ውሳኔ ሃይማኖትን የመለማመድ ነፃነትን የሚጥስ ነው ሲሉ ይተቻሉ። ማህበረሰቡም መንግሥት በግለሰቦች ላይ እርምጃ ከመውሰድ ይልቅ የጸሎት ቤቱን መዝጋቱ በአጠቃላይ አማኞች ላይ የሚደረግ ኢ-ፍትሃዊ ቅጣት ነው በማለት ቅሬታቸውን እየገለጹ ነው።
oromo: Mana murtii Faransaayitti, masjiidni Ataa-qwaa jedhamu kan Aulnay-sous-Bois argamu, shororkeessummaa fi jeequmsa kakaasera jechuun baatii jahaaf akka cufamu murteeffamee ture sun jabaatee itti fufeera. Mootummaan imaamonnii masjiidichaa jibbiinsa fi yaada hammaataa babal'isu jedhee himatus, jiraattonni fi abbootiin seeraa murteen kun bilisummaa amantii kan sarbuudha jechuun mormaniiru. Hawaasni naannichaa, mootummaan namoota yakka raawwatan irratti tarkaanfii fudhachuu dhiisee masjiidicha cufuunsaa namoota nagaa irratti adabbii waldaa ta'eera jechuun gungumii qabu ibsaniiru.

title: Max Verstappen signs new F1 contract with Red Bull until 2030
english: Four-time Formula One champion Max Verstappen has extended his partnership with Red Bull Racing through 2030. This new agreement puts an end to ongoing rumors about him potentially leaving the team or retiring from the sport early. Despite facing a difficult season with his current car, Verstappen expressed his commitment to helping the team return to its winning form.
amharic: የአራት ጊዜ የፎርሙላ ዋን ሻምፒዮኑ ማክስ ቨርስታፔን ከሬድ ቡል እሽቅድምድም ቡድን ጋር የነበረውን ውል እስከ 2030 ድረስ ማራዘሙን አረጋግጧል። ይህ ስምምነት አትሌቱ ቡድኑን ለቆ ሊወጣ ወይም ከውድድር ሊገለል ይችላል የሚል ወሬን አስቆሟል። ምንም እንኳን በዚህ አመት በውድድር ላይ ችግሮች ቢገጥሙትም፣ ቨርስታፔን ቡድኑን እንደገና ወደ ድል ጎዳና ለመመለስ ቁርጠኛ መሆኑን ገልጿል።
oromo: Injifataan tapha Formula One yeroo afur Max Verstappen, waliigaltee isaa garee Red Bull Racing waliin hanga bara 2030 tti dheereffateera. Waliigalteen kun dubbii inni garee kana gadi lakkisee deemu ykn tapha kana dhaaba jedhamee hasa'amaa ture hatattamaan kan dhaabe dha. Garaagarummaan konkolaataa isaa yeroo ammaa isa muudateyyuu, Verstappen garee isaa kana deebisee gara injifannootti fiduuf kutannoo qabaachuu isaa ibseera.

title: Heatwaves and energy crunch: Can Europe withstand a double shock?
english: Europe is currently facing significant economic challenges due to the dual impact of extreme heatwaves and rising energy costs linked to the conflict involving Iran. These environmental conditions are devastating agriculture and reducing productivity, which experts estimate will cost the region roughly 209 billion dollars. This financial strain threatens to erase nearly all of the economic growth projected for the European Union in 2026.
amharic: አውሮፓ በአሁኑ ወቅት በአየር ንብረት መለዋወጥ ሳቢያ በተፈጠረ ከፍተኛ ሙቀት እና ከኢራን ግጭት ጋር በተያያዘ የኃይል ምንጭ ዋጋ መጨመር ምክንያት ከፍተኛ ኢኮኖሚያዊ ችግሮች ገጥመዋታል። ይህ የአየር ሁኔታ በግብርናው ዘርፍ ላይ ጉዳት በማድረስ እና የምርታማነት መጠንን በመቀነስ ወደ 209 ቢሊዮን የአሜሪካ ዶላር የሚገመት የኢኮኖሚ ኪሳራ አስከትሏል። ይህ ከፍተኛ ወጪ የአውሮፓ ህብረት ለፈረንጆቹ 2026 የያዘውን የእድገት እቅድ ሊያከሽፍ እንደሚችል ባለሙያዎች አስጠንቅቀዋል።
oromo: Awurooppaan yeroo ammaa kana ho'a cimaa fi gatii anniisaa waraana Iraan waliin walqabatee dabaleen miidhamtee jirti. Ho'i kun qonnaa fi omishtummaa irratti dhiibbaa geessisaa jiruun, biyyootni Awurooppaa tilmaamaan dolaara biliyoona 209 akka dhaban taasiseera. Dhiibbaan diinagdee kun guddina diinagdee Tokkummaa Awurooppaa kan bara 2026 karoorfame guutummaatti akka gufachiisu sodaatamaa jira.

title: Video shows Russian missile strike on Ukrainian capital
english: A Russian ballistic missile attack on Kyiv early Thursday resulted in at least 12 deaths and dozens of injuries. The strikes caused significant damage to civilian areas, specifically hitting a children's hospital. Ukrainian authorities have condemned the targeting of non-military infrastructure.
amharic: ሐሙስ ዕለት በኪየቭ ከተማ በደረሰ የሩሲያ የባለስቲክ ሚሳይል ጥቃት ቢያንስ 12 ሰዎች መሞታቸውና በርካቶች መቁሰላቸው ተነግሯል። ጥቃቱ የህፃናት ሆስፒታልን ጨምሮ በሲቪል ተቋማት ላይ ያነጣጠረ ነበር። የዩክሬን ባለስልጣናት በሲቪል መሠረተ ልማቶች ላይ የተፈጸመውን ይህን ድርጊት አውግዘዋል።
oromo: Guyyaa Kamisaa ganama magaalaa Kiyiivitti haleellaa rookeettii Ruusiyaan raawwattee kanaan namoonni 12 ol yoo du'an, hedduun immoo madaa'aniiru. Haleellaan kun dhaabbilee siviilii fi hospitaala ijoollee irratti kan xiyyeeffate ture. Abbootiin taayitaa Yukreen miidhaa bu'uuraalee misooma siviilii irratti qaqqabe kana balaaleffataniiru.

title: Ben-Gvir celebrates demolition of Palestinian homes in Israel
english: Israeli minister Itamar Ben-Gvir recently expressed support for the destruction of 10,000 Palestinian homes, describing the demolition process in Ramla as a positive event. The Israeli government claims these structures are being removed because they were built without the necessary construction permits. This action has drawn attention to the ongoing tensions and the displacement of Palestinians within Israel.
amharic: የእስራኤል ባለስልጣን ኢታማር ቤን-ግቪር በቅርቡ 10,000 የፍልስጤማውያን መኖሪያ ቤቶች መፍረሳቸውን በመደገፍ በራምላ የተካሄደውን የቤት ማፍረስ ስራ አወድሰዋል። የእስራኤል መንግስት እነዚህ ቤቶች የተፈረሱት ህጋዊ የግንባታ ፈቃድ ስለሌላቸው እንደሆነ ገልጿል። ይህ ድርጊት በእስራኤል ውስጥ የሚኖሩ ፍልስጤማውያንን የመፈናቀል እና ያለውን ውጥረት አባብሶታል።
oromo: Ministirri Israa'eel Itamaar Ben-Gvir ganda Ramlaa keessatti manni jireenyaa Falisxiinotaa 10,000 ol diigamuu isaa gammachuun kan ibsan yoo ta'u, tarkaanficha baay'ee akka jaallatan dubbataniiru. Mootummaan Israa'eel manneen kun kan diigaman hayyama ijaarsaa seera qabeessa waan hin qabneef akka ta'e ibseera. Tarkaanfin kun lafa Falisxiinotaa irratti dhiibbaa fi buqqaatii uumame irratti xiyyeeffannoo guddaa harkiseera.

title: Netanyahu warns Israel will not tolerate Turkish military presence in Syria
english: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has explicitly stated that his country will not allow Turkish military forces to expand their operations into southern Syria. Following recent Israeli airstrikes on a Syrian military site, Netanyahu confirmed that a formal warning has been issued to Turkey regarding this issue. This move highlights growing tensions over the presence of foreign military powers near Israel's borders.
amharic: የእስራኤል ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ የቱርክ ወታደራዊ ኃይሎች በሶሪያ ደቡባዊ ክፍል መስፋፋትን ሀገራቸው እንደማትታገስ በግልጽ አስታውቀዋል። በእስራኤል በሶሪያ ወታደራዊ ጣቢያ ላይ ከተፈጸመ ጥቃት በኋላ፣ ኔታንያሁ ለቱርክ መንግስት ማስጠንቀቂያ እንደተላለፈ አረጋግጠዋል። ይህ ድርጊት በእስራኤል ድንበር አቅራቢያ ያሉ የውጭ ወታደራዊ ኃይሎች እንቅስቃሴ እየፈጠረ ያለውን ውጥረት ያሳያል።
oromo: Mummichi Ministiraa Israa'el Benyaamiin Netaaniyaahu, waraanni Turkey gara kibba Sooriyaatti akka hin babal'anne biyyi isaanii akka hin hayyamne ibsaniiru. Erga Israa'el buufata waraana Sooriyaa irratti haleellaa raawwattee booda, Netaaniyaahu mootummaan Turkey akeekkachiisa cimaa fudhachuu isaa mirkaneessaniiru. Tarkaanfiin kun daangaa Israa'elitti dhihoo jiru irratti waraana biyyoota alaa ilaalchisee yaaddoon jiraachuu isaa kan agarsiisuudha.

title: Oil flows nearly tripled before US-Iran MoU expired, analysis shows
english: Data indicates that oil exports through the Strait of Hormuz nearly tripled during the 60-day period of a recent US-Iran agreement. Despite this temporary increase, overall shipping volumes remained well below historical levels and slowed down significantly toward the end of the deal. The agreement has now expired without a lasting peace settlement, leaving critical shipping routes vulnerable amid ongoing attacks on commercial vessels.
amharic: የቅርብ ጊዜ መረጃዎች እንደሚያሳዩት በአሜሪካ እና በኢራን መካከል በተደረሰው የ60 ቀናት ስምምነት ወቅት በሆርሙዝ ስትሬት የሚደረገው የነዳጅ ማጓጓዣ መጠን ወደ ሦስት እጥፍ አድጓል። ምንም እንኳን ይህ ጊዜያዊ ጭማሪ ቢታይም፣ አጠቃላይ የንግድ እንቅስቃሴው ከቀድሞው መጠን ጋር ሲነፃፀር አሁንም ዝቅተኛ እንደሆነ ቀጥሏል። ስምምነቱ ያለ ዘላቂ የሰላም ስምምነት በአሁኑ ጊዜ ስላለቀ፣ ለንግድ መርከቦች በሚሰነዘሩ ጥቃቶች ምክንያት ዋና ዋና የባህር መስመሮች አሁንም ለአደጋ ተጋልጠዋል።
oromo: Odeeffannoon akka agarsiisutti, walii galtee guyyaa 60f Amerikaa fi Iraan gidduutti godhame kanaan, gabaan boba’aa karaa Hormuz dabru yeroo sadiin guddachuu danda’eera. Guddinni kun kan ture ta’us, gabaan waliigalaa sadarkaa durii irraa gadi bu’aadha. Walii galichi furmaata nagaa waaraa tokko malee waan xumurameef, karaaleen gurguddoon daldalaa har’as haleellaa dooniiwwan daldalaa irraa kan ka’e balaaf saaxilamanii jiru.

title: Mushroom killer must stay in jail forever for 'truly dreadful' crime, appeal court told
english: Australian prosecutors are arguing that Erin Patterson, who was convicted of murdering three relatives using poisonous mushrooms, should receive a life sentence without the possibility of parole. The legal teams described her actions as a calculated betrayal of trust, noting that she fed her guests deadly meals while lying about her own health. While the prosecution seeks a harsher punishment, Patterson's defense is simultaneously attempting to overturn her initial conviction.
amharic: መርዛማ እንጉዳይ በመጠቀም ሶስት ዘመዶቿን የገደለችው ኤሪን ፓተርሰን፣ ከእስር የመውጣት እድል ሳይኖራት በዕድሜ ልክ እስራት እንድትቀጣ አቃቤ ህግ እየጠየቀ ነው። ባለሥልጣናቱ ወንጀሏ የተፈጸመው በታቀደ እቅድ እና በአሰቃቂ ክህደት እንደሆነ በመግለጽ ቅጣቱ ቀላል እንደሆነ ይከራከራሉ። በሌላ በኩል፣ የፓተርሰን ጠበቆች ጥፋተኛ የተባለችበትን ውሳኔ ለመሻር ይግባኝ ጠይቀዋል።
oromo: Erin Patterson, dubartii firashee sadii kottee summii (mushroom) fayyadamuun ajjeeste, hidhaa bara baraan fi carraa gadi lakkifamu malee akka adabamtu abbaan alangaa gaafataa jira. Gochi kun gantummaa fi karooraan kan raawwatame waan ta'eef, adabbiin ishee amma jiru baay'ee xiqqaa dha jedhamee amanama. Gama biraatiin, abukaatonni Patterson murtee ishee irratti darbe kana jijjiirsisuuf ol-iyyannoo dhiyeessanii jiru.

title: Top seeds Sabalenka, Zverev knocked out of Cincinnati Open
english: Top tennis seeds Aryna Sabalenka and Alexander Zverev were both unexpectedly eliminated during the fourth round of the Cincinnati Open. Sara Bejlek achieved a major upset by defeating the world number one, Sabalenka, in straight sets. Meanwhile, American Tommy Paul overcame a tough challenge and rain delays to knock out French Open champion Zverev. These results serve as a significant disappointment for both stars as they prepare for the upcoming US Open.
amharic: የዓለም ቁጥር አንድ ተጫዋች አሪና ሳባሌንካ እና የፈረንሳይ ኦፕን ሻምፒዮኑ አሌክሳንደር ዝቬሬቭ በሲንሲናቲ ኦፕን ቴኒስ ውድድር አራተኛ ዙር अप्रत्याशित በሆነ መልኩ ተሸንፈው ከውድድሩ ውጪ ሆነዋል። ሳራ ቤሌክ የዓለም አንደኛዋን ሳባሌንካን በማሸነፍ ትልቅ ድንቆን ስታስመዘግብ፣ ቶሚ ፖል ደግሞ በዝናብ የታጀበውን ጨዋታ በማሸነፍ ዝቬሬቭን አሰናብቷል። ይህ ውጤት ሁለቱንም ታላላቅ ተጫዋቾች በቅርቡ ለሚጀመረው የዩኤስ ኦፕን ውድድር ዝግጅታቸው ላይ ከፍተኛ ጫና ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Taphattoonni gurguddoon Aryna Sabalenka fi Alexander Zverev dorgommii Cincinnati Open irratti sadarkaa afuraffaatti tasa mo'atamanii bahaniiru. Sara Bejlek, sadarkaa tokkoffaa addunyaa kan taate Sabalenka mo'achuudhaan dinqisiisaa guddaa uumteetti. Gam biraatiin, Tommy Paul obsaa fi jijjiirama haala qilleensaa kessatti taphatee Zverev injifateera. Bu'aan kun taphattoota lamaanifuu dorgommii US Open dhiyootti eegalamuuf qophiin isaan godhan miidheera.

title: Over 200,000 people newly displaced in Sudan’s Kordofan as fighting rages
english: Escalating conflict in Sudan's Kordofan region has forced over 200,000 people to flee their homes since the end of last year. Persistent attacks on vital infrastructure, including power and water systems in El Obeid, have severely worsened the humanitarian situation. These displacements are compounded by recent heavy flooding in other areas, leaving millions of Sudanese in urgent need of humanitarian aid.
amharic: በሱዳን ኮርዶፋን ክልል እየተባባሰ በመጣው ግጭት ምክንያት ከባለፈው ዓመት መጨረሻ ጀምሮ ከ200,000 በላይ የሚሆኑ ነዋሪዎች ከቀያቸው ተፈናቅለዋል። በኤል ኦቤድ ከተማ በሚገኙ የኤሌክትሪክ እና የውኃ መሰረተ ልማቶች ላይ እየደረሰ ያለው ጥቃት የሰብአዊ ቀውሱን ይበልጥ አባብሶታል። በሌሎች አካባቢዎች የተከሰተው ጎርፍም ችግሩን በማወሳሰብ በሚሊዮን የሚቆጠሩ የሱዳን ዜጎች አስቸኳይ የሰብአዊ ዕርዳታ እንዲያስፈልጋቸው አድርጓል።
oromo: Gogggoggessa biyya Sudaan godina Kordofanitti adeemaa jiruun wal qabatee, namoonni 200,000 ol ta'an dhuma waggaa darbee kaasee qe'ee isaanii irraa buqqa'aniiru. Magaala El Obeiditti bu'uuraalee misoomaa akka humna ibsaa fi bishaanii irratti haleellaan gaggeeffamuun haala namoomaa yeroodhaa gara yerootti akka hammaatu taasiseera. Rakkoo kanaan alatti, lolaan naannolee biroo mudate rakkoo kana caalaatti hammaachiisee, lammiileen Sudaan miliyoonaan lakkaa'aman gargaarsa hatattamaa akka barbaadan taasiseera.

title: Lionel Messi scores first goal for Inter Miami since father’s death
english: Lionel Messi scored his first goal for Inter Miami following the recent passing of his father, Jorge Messi. During the match against the Philadelphia Union, which ended in a 2-2 draw, the star forward paid tribute by gesturing toward the sky after his goal. Despite his efforts, Inter Miami has struggled recently and is currently on a four-game winless streak.
amharic: ሊዮኔል ሜሲ አባቱ ጆርጅ ሜሲ ከዚህ ዓለም በሞት ከተለዩ በኋላ ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ ለኢንተር ማያሚ ግብ አስቆጥሯል። ከፊላደልፊያ ዩኒየን ጋር 2 ለ 2 በተጠናቀቀው ጨዋታ ላይ ሜሲ ግቡን ካስቆጠረ በኋላ ለሟች አባቱ ያለውን ክብር በምልክት አሳይቷል። ምንም እንኳን ሜሲ ጥሩ ብቃት ቢኖረውም ኢንተር ማያሚ ላለፉት አራት ጨዋታዎች ድልን ማጣቱ ለቡድኑ ፈታኝ ሆኗል።
oromo: Lionel Messi abbaan isaa Jorge Messi erga du'anii booda tapha Inter Miami'f jalqabaa galcheera. Tapha Philadelphia Union wajjin 2-2 xumurame irratti, erga galchii galchee booda gara samii agarsiisuun abbaa isaa yaadateera. Messi gaarii taphatee kan ture ta'us, Inter Miami taphoota afur darban keessatti injifannoo argachuu dadhabee jira.

title: Bangladesh holds presidential election in first contested vote in 35 years
english: Bangladesh is conducting its first competitive presidential election in 35 years following the resignation of the previous president. The ruling party's candidate, Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir, faces opposition nominee Oli Ahmed in a vote held by the country's lawmakers. Although the ruling party holds a strong numerical advantage that makes the outcome predictable, the event marks a significant symbolic step in the nation's democratic recovery.
amharic: ባንግላዲሽ የቀድሞው ፕሬዚዳንት ከስልጣን መልቀቃቸውን ተከትሎ ላለፉት 35 ዓመታት ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ ተወዳዳሪ ያለበት የፕሬዚዳንታዊ ምርጫ እያካሄደች ነው። የገዢው ፓርቲ እጩ ሚርዛ ፋክሩል ኢስላም አላምጊር እና የተቃዋሚው ጥምረት እጩ ኦሊ አህመድ በፓርላማ አባላት ድምጽ ይወዳደራሉ። ምንም እንኳን የገዢው ፓርቲ አብላጫ ድምጽ ውጤቱ አስቀድሞ እንዲታወቅ የሚያደርግ ቢሆንም፣ ይህ ምርጫ ለሀገሪቱ ዲሞክራሲያዊ ሂደት ትልቅ ምልክት ተደርጎ ተወስዷል።
oromo: Bangladesh erga pirezidaantiin duraanii aangoo gadhiisanii booda, waggoota 35 keessatti yeroo jalqabaaf filannoo pirezidaantummaa morkii qabu geggeessaa jirti. Kaadhimamaan paartii biyya bulchu Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir fi kaadhimamaan mormitootaa Oli Ahmed miseensota mana maree biyyattii gidduutti wal dorgomu. Giddu galeessaan paartiin biyya bulchu harka caalu qabaachuun isaa bu'aan filannichaa akka beekamu kan taasisu ta'us, filannoon kun deebi'ee dhaabbachuu dimokraasii biyyattii keessatti tarkaanfii fakkeenya ta'e dha.

title: After Gaza, can Muslims defend Al-Aqsa Mosque?
english: Concerns are growing that the Al-Aqsa Mosque faces a serious risk of structural and administrative changes as discussions about altering the site gain traction in Israeli politics. The article questions whether the global Muslim community can effectively protect the site, noting that past responses to the humanitarian crisis in Gaza have been largely ineffective. Ultimately, the author urges Muslims to reflect on whether their personal comforts and priorities have hindered their ability to mobilize and act decisively in defense of their religious sites.
amharic: በእስራኤል የፖለቲካ መድረክ የአል-አቅሳ መስጂድ አስተዳደርን እና ይዘትን ለመቀየር የሚደረጉ ንግግሮች እየጠነከሩ መምጣታቸው ትልቅ ስጋት ፈጥሯል። የጋዛ ቀውስ እንዳሳየው ዓለም አቀፍ ሙስሊሞች ለተፈጠረው ችግር ተፅእኖ ፈጣሪ የሆነ ምላሽ ለመስጠት ተቸግረዋል። ደራሲው ሙስሊሞች ከጋዛ ድርጊቶች ተምረው ለሃይማኖታዊ ቦታዎቻቸው ጥበቃ ሲባል የራሳቸውን ምቾት ወደ ጎን በመተው በጋራ ለመቆም ዝግጁ መሆናቸውን እንዲመረምሩ ይጠይቃል።
oromo: Mariiwwan masjiida Al-Aqsa jijjiiruuf mootummaa Israa’el keessatti taasifamaa jiran hubannoo fi nageenya iddoo kanaa irratti yaaddoo guddaa uumee jira. Rakkoon Gaza keessatti mul’ate akka agarsiisutti, hawaasni Muslimaa addunyaa rakkoo akkasii irratti tarkaanfii qabatamaa fudhachuu irratti dadhabina qaba. Barreessaan kun, Muslimoonni mudannoo Gaza irraa barachuun, faayidaa fi tasgabbii dhuunfaa isaanii aarsaa gochuun bakka amantii isaanii kana ittisuuf walta'uun socho'uu akka qaban gaafata.

title: Iran's Araghchi says Trump's 'Economic D-Day' is a diversion from US domestic problems
english: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi dismissed Donald Trump's threat of severe economic warfare, labeling it a distraction from the United States' own internal financial crises. Araghchi argued that these aggressive policies are unsuccessful and will only increase opposition from the Iranian people. He further warned that such actions undermine global stability and threaten the sovereignty of nations worldwide.
amharic: የኢራን የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር አባስ አራግቺ ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በኢራን ላይ የኢኮኖሚ ጦርነት እንደሚያውጁ የሰጡትን ማስፈራሪያ ውድቅ በማድረግ፣ ይህም የአሜሪካን የውስጥ የኢኮኖሚ ችግሮች ለመሸፈን የሚደረግ ሙከራ ነው ብለዋል። አራግቺ እነዚህ ውድቅ የሆኑ ፖሊሲዎች ተቀባይነት እንደሌላቸውና የኢራን ሕዝብን ተቃውሞ እንደሚጨምሩ ገልጸዋል። በተጨማሪም እንዲህ ዓይነቱ እርምጃ በዓለም አቀፍ ኢኮኖሚ ላይ ሥጋት እንደሚፈጥርና የሌሎች አገሮችን ሉዓላዊነት እንደሚጋፋ አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Ministirri Dhimmi Alaa Iraan Abbas Araghchi, Donald Trump, Iraan irratti duula diinagdee cimaa banuuf sodaachisuu isaanii kan balaaleffatan yoo ta'u, kunis rakkoo diinagdee Amerikaa keessoo dhoksuuf kan yaalame dha jedhan. Araghchi akka ibsanitti, imaammanni kun kan hin milkoofneefi uummata Iraan biratti mormii caalu kan uumuudha. Dabalataanis, tarkaanfiin kun diinagdee addunyaa irratti miidhaa akka geessisuufi walaba ta'uu biyyoota addunyaa kan miidhu ta'uu akeekkachiisaniiru.

title: Morning update
english: President Trump has threatened severe economic sanctions against any nation that supports Iran, though specific details remain unclear. Meanwhile, tensions are rising as Israel critiques Turkey's actions in Syria and the UK prepares potential sanctions against Israeli officials involved in West Bank settlement expansion. Additionally, the family of a young Palestinian girl killed in a recent conflict is demanding an independent international investigation into her death, rejecting a previous Israeli military probe.

Gama biraatiin, maatiin mucayyoo Falasxiin kan wareegamte Hind Raajaab, qorannoon waraanni Israa'el gaggeesse kan amansiisu miti jedhanii, qorannoo idil-addunyaa walaba ta'e akka taasifamu gaafataniiru.

title: Israeli opposition leader and former prime minister criticise Netanyahu over Syria attacks
english: Israeli opposition figures Yair Golan and Ehud Barak have strongly criticized Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu for a recent military strike in Syria. They argue that the attack was a reckless political move that threatens Israel's relationship with Turkey and undermines national security. The critics claim Netanyahu is prioritizing his own political survival over regional stability, calling for more responsible leadership.

oromo: Hoggantoonni mormituu Israa'el Ya'iir Golaanii fi muummichi ministeeraa duraanii Ehud Baaraak, haleellaa dhiyeenya kana Siriyaa irratti raawwatamee fi igeruu muummicha ministeeraa Beenjaamiin Netaanyaahuyyu irratti cimsanii qeeqaniiru. Qeeqtonni kunneen haleellaan kun tarkaanfii siyaasaa of eeggannoo hin qabne ta'uu fi hariiroo Israa'elii fi Turkii miidhuu danda'a jedhu. Netaanyaahuu nageenya biyyaa caalaa fayyidaa siyaasaa ofii isaaniitiif akka dhama'anitti kan isaan himatan yoo ta'u, gaggeessummaa tasgabbii fidu barbaachisa jedhaniiru.

title: Israeli defence minister warns Turkey against 'threatening its security'
english: Israel's defense minister, Israel Katz, has issued a sharp warning to Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan regarding his recent foreign policy actions in Syria. Katz cautioned that Turkey is heading toward dangerous territory and insisted that Israel will not tolerate any threats to its national safety. He suggested that Erdogan should focus on his political rhetoric at home rather than challenging Israel's resolve to defend itself.

Kaatz Tarkii gocha akkaan balaa qabu keessa akka jirtu ibsuun, Israa'el nageenya biyyattii irratti balaan kamiyyuu akka ga'u akka hin hayyamne beeksisaniiru. Erdogaan Israa'el irratti dubbii arrabsoo oofuu mannaa, fedhii Israa'el of ittisuuf qabdu qoruun isaan irra akka hin jiraanne gorsaniiru.

title: Australian anger as Israel drops World Central Kitchen deaths case
english: The Australian government has formally protested Israel’s decision to close the criminal investigation into the 2024 Gaza airstrike that killed seven World Central Kitchen aid workers, including an Australian citizen. Canberra expressed deep frustration and summoned the Israeli ambassador to voice their disapproval of this outcome. This move follows widespread global criticism regarding the lack of accountability for the tragedy.

oromo: Mootummaan Awustiraaliyaa, bara 2024 Gaazaatti hojjettoota dhaabbata gargaarsaa 'World Central Kitchen' torba irratti xiyyaaraan haleellaa gaggeeffameen lubbuun isaanii darbuu hordofee, Israa'el qorannoo yakkaa cufuushee balaaleffatteetti. Murteen yakka irratti himata akka hin banne Israa'el murteessite kun, sadarkaa idil-addunyaatti gaddi guddaan akka uumamu taasiseera.

title: Founder of collapsed Chinese property giant Evergrande sentenced to life in prison
english: Hui Ka Yan, the founder of the massive Chinese real estate firm Evergrande, has been sentenced to life in prison following his conviction for embezzlement and bribery. The company, which once led China's property market, collapsed in 2021 after years of aggressive borrowing and the misuse of funds intended for home construction. In addition to his prison term, Hui faces the total seizure of his personal assets, while the company has been ordered to pay significant fines for its role in the industry's economic downturn.

Murtee hidhaa kana cinaatti, qabeenyii dhuunfaa isaa guututti kan mootummaatti fudhatamu yoo ta'u, dhaabbatichis miidhaa diinagdee geessiseef adabbii maallaqa guddaa akka kaffalu ajajameera.

title: Exclusive: Pentagon sends ‘political loyalty’ survey to US allies
english: The Pentagon has issued a questionnaire to 31 NATO member nations to assess their political loyalty toward the United States. This unusual move highlights a shift in diplomatic approach, prioritizing firm allegiance to the current administration. Experts suggest this strategy aligns with President Trump’s emphasis on personal and national loyalty in international relations.

title: At least 6 killed in multiple Russian missile strikes across Ukraine
english: Russian ballistic missiles targeted Ukraine's capital city early Thursday, resulting in at least six fatalities and over twenty-four injuries. The attacks caused widespread fires after hitting residential areas and a medical facility for children. Authorities are currently managing the aftermath of this significant escalation in urban strikes.

Aangeyyoonni biyyattii miidhaa weerara kanaa tasgabbeessuuf carraaqqii gochaa jiru.

title: Russia launches missile strikes on Kyiv and surrounding region, killing at least eight
english: Russian forces conducted a major missile attack on Kyiv and its surrounding areas, resulting in at least eight deaths and over thirty injuries. The strikes damaged civilian infrastructure including apartment buildings, a children's hospital, and warehouses, while also causing widespread power outages. Additionally, authorities in neighboring Romania and Poland reported air security concerns after a drone entered Romanian territory and military defenses were activated in Poland.
